test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The book was read by the student in just two days.

options.text: The student was reading the book in just two days.
The book is read by the student in just two days.
The student has read the book in just two days.
The student read the book in just two days.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is currently in the passive voice: "The book was read by the student in just two days."
 
• In the passive voice, the subject of the action ("the student") comes after the verb, and the object of the action ("the book") is emphasized.
 
• To convert this to the active voice, the subject ("the student") should come before the verb, and the object ("the book") should follow the verb.
 
• The correct active voice sentence is: "The student read the book in just two days."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The student read the book in just two days."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "The student was reading the book in just two days." **– This sentence is in the past continuous tense, which does not match the original sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "The book is read by the student in just two days."** – This sentence is in the present passive voice, which is incorrect.
 
• **Option 3: "The student has read the book in just two days."** – This sentence is in the present perfect tense, which does not match the original sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "The student read the book in just two days."** – This sentence is in the past tense and is the correct active voice conversion of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 5: (Blank)** – This option is irrelevant as it is not provided.
